responsibility: Defines Andes NDS32’s common target hook layer, combining validation of NDS32-specific option arguments, architecture-wide optimization defaults, default target flag composition, and exception-unwind policy. It checks ISR vector/security and cache-block-size options, enables or disables several scheduler/frame-pointer/relaxation defaults depending on optimization mode and ABI, selects DWARF2 unwinding for Linux and SJLJ otherwise, and exports the targetm_common instance for the backend.
